# s292 — affected.py skips selected test ids that no longer load

When the map selects a test id that the working tree no longer defines (renamed or deleted), `tests/affected.py --run` drops it with a stderr note and asks for the full discover, instead of failing the run with a loader error.

**Findings:** s277 relay 2026-10-15: `affected.py --run` with a borrowed map selected `test_Rows_BlockedReviewAndParked_ShowMarkerWithoutAClaimColumn`, which the slice had renamed, and the run reported an AttributeError instead of running the renamed test · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** recording renames in the map, and changing which tests a diff selects.

## Why

A map is recorded at a commit; a slice that renames or deletes a test still has the old id in the map. `--run` passes the ids to unittest, which raises AttributeError for each missing one, so a green slice looks red until someone notices the error is a ghost. s277 hit it on 2026-10-15.

## Files

- `tests/affected.py`: before running, load each selected id with `unittest.TestLoader().loadTestsFromName`; collect the ones that fail to load, print them on stderr, run the rest, and exit 2 with "run the full discover" when any were dropped, since a renamed test may need running.
- `tests/test_affected.py`, `CHANGELOG.md`.

- `test_Run_AllSelectedIdsLoad_Unchanged`
